summary: All 11 first-pass findings independently reproduced and confirmed at their original severities (3 blockers, 5 major, 3 minor): correct physics FAILS steptest on 80.3/80.4/80.5/80.6 while a reconstructed buggy reference (consecutive-row 'chain' pairs, signed scalar +dV/dr broadcast over x,y,z) PASSES bit-exactly; 80.7's band tests pass a no-simulation stub and chain-broken dynamics yet fail a correct implementation that trusts the documented N=200 (arrays carry 216 particles). required_dependencies exec cleanly; no missed defects found. The problem is fixable to fair with moderate-to-high effort: doc edits for 80.2/80.4/80.7, trivial test edits (N=216, seeds, num_steps) for 80.7, but 80.3/80.5/80.6 need their h5 targets regenerated from a corrected all-pairs vector-force reference (regen code already in review/work/80/verify/v_correct.py), and 80.7 needs new deterministic assertions to stop scoring stubs as correct.
